children: Overview
France wine and spirits group's H1 2026 revenue declined 4.4% yr/yr amid global challenges
EBITDA for H1 2026 fell to €4.9 mln from €5.9 mln in H1 2025
Net profit for H1 2026 dropped to €2.1 mln, reflecting lower operating profit
Outlook
Company expects ongoing positive momentum in France, driven by William Peel and new product launches
International performance expected to decline in Eastern Europe due to external factors and customer challenges
Company to maintain operational agility and cost control amid ongoing macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainty
Result Drivers
FRANCE RECOVERY - Gradual recovery in William Peel distribution and new product launches from Marie Brizard and Sobieski supported revenue growth in France
INTERNATIONAL HEADWINDS - Declining sales in Lithuania and Ukraine due to rising excise duties and conflict disruption weighed on international results
COST MANAGEMENT - Continued rigorous cost management helped offset pressures, particularly at the holding company level
